title: The Deepest Hall
journal: The Eye of Argonia is the old priest-kings' jewel. It sits at the Root, under the sea below Teku-Sul Spire, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there, it can heal every sick tree. The last king shut it behind the Kings' Gate, which opens only with three seal-stones. The third seal-stone lies in the vault of Vorannuhl's deep halls, behind a door of bronze. Sarpa raiders shelter in the outer yard, and one of them, Hesh-Var, carries the bronze key. I'm to get the key: lift it from him unseen, or kill him and take it.
objectives: Get the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl from Hesh-Var in the outer yard. (marker: Hesh-Var, Vorannuhl)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am hunting the third seal-stone, in Vorannuhl's deep vault, the hardest place of the hunt
plan.next: get the bronze key from Hesh-Var at the yard's fire
plan.ways: pickpocket it from him unseen (Sneak and Pickpocket), or fight the raiders and take it from his body (any fighting skill); the raiders shoot strangers

answers: I am hunting the three seal-stones to open the Kings Gate and reach the Eye of Argonia at the Root. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the vault of Vorannuhl behind a bronze door. The Eye used in place heals the trees; lifting it harms them, so I must not lift it. Rivals are the Unbound and the collector Ennodius Vanin.
Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door.

Sneak and pickpocket the key from Hesh-Var, or kill him and take it. I favour sneaking. I could also try the locked vault door by lockpicking (2 lockpicks), though it is bronze and probably needs the key. Paralysis poison is available too.

I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. Plague-Dead of Vorannuhl are here and I am unsure how dangerous they are; I can find out by looking and talking.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I have the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls, and their lord, a wraith, guards the vault. I'm to go down, open the vault with the key and take the stone. I can fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Open the Vault of the Household with the bronze key and take the seal-stone. (marker: Door to Vault of the Household, Household's Hoard)

plan.going: I hold the key; the stone is in the vault below
plan.next: go down, open the vault, take the stone
plan.ways: fight the plague-dead and the wraith-lord; sneak past them; turn them with Restoration

answers: I lifted the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var unseen. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault holding the third seal-stone.
Go to the Door to Vault of the Household and open it with the key, then take the seal-stone.
Fight the dead, slip past them by sneaking, or turn them with Restoration (I am not sure I have that skill).
I do not know how strong the wraith lord is or what turning the dead involves; I will look around and see.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice ordered all three brought to her before anyone goes near the gate. I'm to bring them to her in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.

plan.going: I hold all three seal-stones of the Kings' Gate
plan.next: bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom, as her orders said, before going to the gate
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: Notes for a friend picking up the save: I lifted the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var unseen (pickpocket), opened the Vault of the Household in Vorannuhl, and took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Household Hoard (use the hoard, then take the stone). The Lord of Vorannuhl was in the vault and I did not fight. I now carry all three seal-stones: Blackrose, Gemin and Kings. Never-Writes-Twice ordered all three brought to her before anyone goes near the gate.
Next: bring the stones to her in Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom. After that, the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire (dive from Bell Station).

I could go straight to Helstrom as ordered, or head to the gate myself; I think delivering them first is wiser. Do not lift the Eye: used in place it heals the trees, lifted it cuts them off and the weak die alone. Rivals: the Unbound and Collector Ennodius Vanin. I have about 350 gold, Reel-Ka armour, rapier, 2 lockpicks, 3 paralysis poisons, sap jar, keystone, eye-setting.
Still unknown: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound.
